Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:4861
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 15065 of 2023
Applicant :- Ravi Chauhan @ Sitaram Chauhan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Naveen Kumar Pandey,Kusuma Devi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Lalu Prasad Bhatt
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Lalu Prasad Bhatt, learned counsel for the respondent no.2 as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. Counter affidavit filed on behalf of the respondent State is taken on record.
3. In terms of the F.I.R., initially a missing person report was lodged.
Subsequently, in the statements under Sections 161 1nd 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and disclosed her age as 18 years.
She further stated that she married with the applicant.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail relying upon a school leaving certificate and argued that as the document, age of the victim is less than 18 years.
Ravi Chauhan @ Sitaram Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

entities.text: Ravi Chauhan @ Sitaram Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. Learned counsel for the applicant further argued that as there is no document on record prescribed under the Juvenile Justice Act and the rules framed thereunder to form a view with regard to age determination of the victim, as such the same would be decided at the time of trial in view of the law laid down in the case of Monish Vs. State of U.P. passed by this Court in Crl. Misc.
Bail Application No.55026 of 2021 decided on 9.2.2023.

entities.text:
Crl. Misc.
Bail Application No.55026 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal history and is in jail since 12.8.2023, hence the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

6. Considering the fact that the two statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. do not corroborate the prosecution story; the applicant has no criminal history and is languishing in jail since 12.8.2023; the age of the victim is to be determined at the time of the trial in view of the law laid down in the case of Monish Vs. State of U.P.(supra) as well as in terms of the Juvenile Justice Act and the rules framed thereunder, and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Ravi Chauhan @ Sitaram Chauhan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.384 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) I.P.C. and Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act, Police Station Wazirganj, District Gonda on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
